mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below its 5-year average signals accommodative monetary policy, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in UNRATE above 10% indicates elevated labor cost pressures, eroding corporate profit margins and triggering negative investor sentiment, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns despite UNRATE crossing above 10%, with no significant correlation between the trigger and return direction (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in GDPC1 (demand) and decline in FEDFUNDS (monetary easing) signals accommodative policy and expanding economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increased in past month and FEDFUNDS decreased in past month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive when both proxies move as predicted (p > 0.05), or returns are negative despite the signal.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS below its 5-year average and rising GDPC1 (demand) reflect accommodative monetary policy, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive in late-cycle expansion periods despite the signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both supply (INDPRO) and demand (GDPC1) proxies indicates robust economic growth, reducing excess capacity and driving upward pressure on asset prices, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both INDPRO and GDPC1 increased in past month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive when both proxies increase, or returns are negative despite the signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden surge in labor participation (PAYEMS) above 140,000 suggests potential over-employment, triggering market anxiety about wage pressures and reduced corporate profits, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns positive despite PAYEMS crossing above 140,000, with no significant correlation (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in INDPRO (supply) above its 5-year average reflects expanding production capacity, which, when absorbed by demand, supports economic growth and equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly positive when INDPRO is above average, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, a sustained drop in UNRATE below 6.5% signals improving labor market conditions, reducing unemployment pressures and boosting consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive in post-shock recovery periods despite the signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.
